facts.overview: Drawn from elements of West African folk tales, it depicts how a newborn boy, Kirikou, saves his village from the evil witch Karaba.
facts.title: Kirikou and the Sorceress

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can a clever newborn boy uncover a way to outwit a formidable sorceress and rescue his endangered village?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Drawing from West African folk tales, this animated adventure follows Kirikou, a precocious newborn boy who immediately sets out to protect his imperiled village from the powerful sorceress Karaba.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Vibrant, brisk, and family-friendly, balancing exciting folk-tale stakes with an accessible 71-minute pace.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Michel Ocelot crafts a vibrant, concise fantasy adventure that reimagines traditional folklore into a spirited and visually distinctive animated journey.
